sentences.text:
The court, while directing issue of notice to the Respondents herein to show cause as to why this application should not be complied with, made the following order.(The receipt of this order will be deemed to be the receipt of notice in the case).
ORDER

Sri Gundala Siva Prasad Reddy, learned counsel for the Petitioner(s) would submit that, initially a case in Crime No.159 of 2022 for the offence under Section 420 IPC was registered against the Petitioner and in that regard five cheques have been taken from the Petitioner and this is the fifth complaint.
It is further submitted that, in all the four cases, there is an interim order in favour of the Petitioner.
It Is further submitted that the very same order may be passed in this matter also.
Considering the submissions, let there be stay of all further proceedings In C.C.No.318 of 2024 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate, Prohibition & Excise Court, Kurnool.
